stories.headline: Mistral reaches $24 billion valuation
stories.summary: Mistral raised €3 billion at a €21 billion ($24 billion) valuation in what it called Europe's largest private-tech equity round. The company says it will invest in models and frontier research.

stories.headline: Huawei's US criminal trial begins
stories.summary: Huawei heads to trial in Brooklyn on bank-fraud, sanctions, trade-secret and related charges. Huawei has pleaded not guilty and says the U.S. case seeks to undermine its competitiveness.

stories.headline: Houthi attacks wound 73 in Saudi Arabia
stories.summary: Iran-backed Houthis attacked four southern Saudi cities and energy facilities, authorities said, wounding 73. Verified aftermath images were not immediately available; the expansion risks further oil disruption.

stories.headline: Russia strikes Kyiv after envoy visit
stories.summary: Russian missiles and drones killed three people and wounded 16 in Kyiv, Ukrainian officials said, after a brief pause during U.S. envoys' visit. Russia said it struck military and logistics targets.

stories.headline: Black boxes recovered after Miami cargo crash
stories.summary: The NTSB recovered both recorders from an Amazon Prime Air cargo jet that overran a Miami runway, killing five people on the ground. Investigators have not determined the cause.
